entries.title: An Automation rule on a failed GitHub workflow run also hears a run that stopped itself
entries.body: A GitHub Actions run that stops its other jobs once one fails can end as cancelled instead of failed. An Automation rule on "A workflow run fails" now hears such a run, naming its failed jobs. A run cancelled with no failed job, such as one a newer push replaced, is still left out.
entries.noPicture: This changes when an existing Automation event fires and what it reports; no screen changes.
